subject: microbiology
title: Vibrio cholerae O1 and O139, El Tor and Classical Biotypes

steps.tx: **Vibrio cholerae** is a curved gram negative motile bacillus (comma shaped, single polar flagellum) whose toxigenic **O1 and O139 serogroups** cause epidemic cholera. O1 splits into classical and **El Tor biotypes** (El Tor now global, haemolytic and hardier traditions), each with Inaba, Ogawa and rare Hikojima serotypes by O antigen variation. Non O1 strains cause sporadic diarrhoea and wound sepsis without epidemics. Regional laboratories also keep freeze dried antisera for rapid slide agglutination during the first suspected cases.
steps.say: Curved, motile, O1 toxin armed: epidemic cholera has a serogroup address.

left.title: Identity
points: Yellow on TCBS, alkaline peptone enrichment

right.title: Biotype split
points: Classical: historic pandemics one to six
El Tor: seventh pandemic, environmental persistence
El Tor variants now carry classical toxin genes

steps.tx: **Cholera disease** is toxin mediated secretory diarrhoea without invasion: rice water stools (isotonic, flecked mucus) litres per day, vomiting, rapid dehydration, hypokalaemia, acidosis and shock, fever absent, gut mucosa intact. Rehydration (oral and intravenous by severity) is the therapy antibiotics only shorten; physiology is the treatment.
steps.say: No invasion, no fever, litres of rice water: replace fluid faster than toxin secretes it.

left.title: Clinical portrait
points: Muscle cramps, weak pulse, sunken eyes

right.title: Rehydration law
points: ORS for most, IV Ringer lactate severe

steps.tx: **Environmental Vibrio life** (estuaries, copepods and plankton, biofilms, viable but nonculturable states) seeds epidemics when water and sanitation fail, humans shedding hyperinfectious fresh stool vibrios transiently. Cholera control is therefore water infrastructure with vaccine and case management as bridges.
steps.say: Cholera lives in estuaries and explodes through broken water systems.

right.title: Control stack
points: Oral cholera vaccines reactive and preventive

steps.tx: **Pandemic history** (seven pandemics, classical giving way to El Tor in 1961, O139 Bengal 1992 regional scare, Haiti 2010 importation lesson) maps cholera to trade, pilgrimage and disaster routes. Genomics now assigns outbreak ancestry within days, assigning responsibility and vaccine strategy.
steps.say: Pandemics travel trade routes; genomes read their tickets now.

left.title: Pandemic notes
points: First six classical from Ganges delta

right.title: Modern surveillance
points: Toxin gene ctxAB and TCP island tracked

steps.tx: **Laboratory diagnosis in outbreaks** is clinical first (dehydration plus rice water in epidemic), culture TCBS and alkaline peptone confirmation for first cases and surveillance ends, rapid dipstick (O1 and O139 antigen) field triage imperfect, PCR ctx where available. After confirmation, most cases are managed syndromically.
steps.say: Culture the first cases to prove the outbreak, then treat the syndrome at scale.

left.title: Bench chain
points: Stool or rectal swab in Cary Blair

steps.tx: **Oral cholera vaccines** (killed whole cell with and without toxin B subunit, live attenuated single dose traveller) protect about 60 to 85 percent for years graded, used reactively in outbreaks and preventively in hotspots, herd effects amplifying. Vaccine never substitutes rehydration corners where patients arrive.
steps.say: Vaccine slows outbreaks; ORS corners decide who survives them.

left.title: Vaccine roster
points: Dukoral: WC plus CTB, two doses
Shanchol and Euvichol: WC only, two doses, stockpile

right.title: Campaign logic
points: Reactive single dose strategies in shortage
Case fatality under 1 percent is programme standard

steps.tx: **Non O1 non O139 vibrios** (including toxigenic rare, and Vibrio cholerae gastroenteritis sporadic) plus species next lessons (parahaemolyticus seafood, vulnificus sepsis) share oxidase and TCBS family habits; stool panels now detect cholera toxin genes specifically so serogroup still needs culture for public health.
steps.say: Toxin gene positive is not serogroup; public health still wants the isolate.

left.title: Non epidemic cholerae
points: No epidemic potential without ctx and TCP in O1 and O139 patterns

right.title: Bench separation
points: Report as non O1 non O139 cholerae
ctx PCR by reference in outbreaks

steps.tx: **Cholera case fatality** is the audit number: untreated severe cholera kills half, well run rehydration under one percent, so outbreak mortality measures logistics (ORS supply, IV fluids, staffing, referral) more than microbiology. The organism's lesson ends as a health systems examination.
steps.say: Cholera deaths audit water and rehydration logistics, not toxin cleverness.

Fatality rate audits the system under 1 percent
